name: Inquisitor: export endpoints security review
summary: Security review of new export, share-link and hook endpoints whose flaws only show across files.
prompt: This Quillstone change adds invoice exports, share links, a billing webhook and an ops reindex hook, and it needs a security review before it ships. change.diff is the diff and PULL_REQUEST.md is the author's description; src/exports.mjs, src/shares.mjs, src/hooks.mjs and src/routes.mjs are the post-change files, and the rest of the repository is there for context. Write review.json as {"findings":[{"file":"src/exports.mjs","line":1,"severity":"high","title":"Describe the vulnerability and its impact"}]}, replacing the example and using line numbers from the post-change files. List only vulnerabilities this change introduces that an attacker could actually use; we already track general hardening ideas elsewhere, so leave those out. Don't edit the source files, install packages or use the network.
